list.noneMatchHint: Try another name or path, or clear the search.

page.subtitle_one: {{n}} directory imported. Its worktrees belong to it.
page.subtitle_other: {{n}} directories imported. Their worktrees belong to them.
page.emptyHint: Import a directory to make it a project, or create one in the workspace.

candidates.firstTitle: Start with the directories you already work in
candidates.firstBody: Claude Code has run in these directories the most. Import the ones that are projects: their chats join them, and the rest stay out of the way. You can import any other directory by hand.
candidates.moreBody: Import them to group their chats, see them in Usage and start chats from here.

card.purged: Purged what Claude Code kept about {{name}}
card.removeBody_one: Agentry forgets this directory. Nothing on disk changes, and importing it again brings its chat back.
card.removeBody_other: Agentry forgets this directory. Nothing on disk changes, and importing it again brings its {{n}} chats back.
card.purgeTitle: Purge what Claude Code keeps about {{name}}?
card.purgeBody_one: This deletes its transcripts, background tasks, file history and its entry in Claude Code's configuration (claude project purge), so its chat is gone for good. Your files are not touched. The project stays imported. This cannot be undone.
card.purgeBody_other: This deletes its transcripts, background tasks, file history and its entry in Claude Code's configuration (claude project purge), so its {{n}} chats are gone for good. Your files are not touched. The project stays imported. This cannot be undone.

worktrees.title: Worktrees
worktrees.emptyBody: Worktrees made with <mono>git worktree add</mono>, or by an orchestration task, show up here.

settings.environmentHint: what Claude actually loaded in the last chat here
settings.cliHint: The configuration the CLI reads in this project: CLAUDE.md, settings, MCP servers and files.

board.name: Board
board.description: Tasks in five columns, milestones, and their link with chats and orchestrations.

team.name: Team
team.description: Agents with a role, a model and what they may write, in .claude/agents/.

documents.name: Documents
documents.description: The repository's docs/ folder and the documents the agents write.

memory.name: Shared memory
memory.description: CLAUDE.md, the project's memory and a journal every agent receives.

modules.offMeansBrief: Switching a module off hides it and keeps its data
modules.offMeansShort: Switching a module off hides its tab and keeps its data. Switching it on brings everything back.
modules.offMeansLong: Switching a module off hides its tab and keeps its data. Switching it on again brings everything back, as it was. No switch deletes anything.

simple.name: Simple
simple.description: A name and a directory. No modules.

software.name: Professional software
software.description: Every module, the four task types and a team of four roles.

library.name: Library or package
library.description: Board, documents and memory. A limit of 2 in progress.

research.name: Research or documentation
research.description: Documents and memory, and a board without bugs.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: Everything off: you choose each module.

prefix.empty: The key prefix cannot be empty
prefix.pattern: Upper-case letters and digits, starting with a letter, 2 to 10 characters
prefix.taken: {{prefix}} is already used by another project

wizard.subtitle: A directory, a template and the modules you want. Everything can be changed later.
wizard.templateHint: Preselects modules, task types, limits and the starting team.
wizard.modulesHintPhone: {{template}} preselected these. Change them now or later in the project's settings.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.folderEmpty: The name needs a letter or a digit: the new folder is named after it.
wizard.folderTaken: The workspace already has a folder called {{folder}}. Pick another name, or import that folder as a directory.
wizard.candidateHint_one: The directory already has {{n}} Claude Code chat: it is grouped in the project.
wizard.candidateHint_other: The directory already has {{n}} Claude Code chats: they are grouped in the project.
wizard.importHint: Every chat that ran under the directory becomes part of the project. A git worktree is refused: import its repository.
wizard.emptyHint: Leave the directory empty to create a new one in the workspace.
wizard.gitHint: The repository is cloned into the workspace.
wizard.inWorkspace: a new directory in the workspace
wizard.teamHint: Offered once the project exists: each role you accept gets its agent file in .claude/agents/.
wizard.keyFailed: The project was created, but its key prefix could not be set
wizard.renameFailed: The project was created, but it could not be renamed

general.title: General
general.name: Name
general.prefixHint: Keys are composed when they are read: a new prefix renames <mono>{{from}}</mono> at once. The number never changes and is never reused.
general.prefixHintChange: Keys are composed when they are read: <mono>{{from}}</mono> will read <mono>{{to}}</mono>. The number never changes and is never reused.
general.limitsHint: A limit per column. Going over it is allowed: the column says so in words, and nothing is blocked.
general.removeBody: It stops showing in Agentry. Its settings and its tasks are kept: import the directory again and everything comes back. The repository is not touched.
general.saveFailed: Could not save the project settings
